title: If we go ... If you see ... etc.
summary: Условные предложения о реальном будущем и общих фактах: **If it rains, we'll stay at home**. После **if** — настоящее время, в главной части — **will**.
ru:
## Что выражает if
**If** значит «если». Мы используем его, когда говорим, что может случиться, и что будет в этом случае.
> **If** it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home. — Если завтра пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.
> **If** you see Tom, tell him to call me. — Если увидишь Тома, скажи ему позвонить мне.

## Правило: if + Present simple, will + глагол
После **if** о будущем ставим **Present simple** (не will!). Результат выражаем через **will**.
> **If** I **have** time, I'**ll help** you. — Если у меня будет время, я тебе помогу.
> **If** she **doesn't come**, we **won't start**. — Если она не придёт, мы не начнём.
Как и после **when**: ~~If I will have time~~ — неверно.

## Порядок частей
**If**-часть может стоять первой (с запятой) или второй (без запятой).
> **If** you're late, I'll be angry. = I'll be angry **if** you're late.

## Вместо will можно
- **can, may, must, should**, команда (Imperative): *If you're tired, **go** to bed.* / *If you want, you **can** stay.*

## if и when
- **when** — событие точно произойдёт: *When I get home, I'll call you.*
- **if** — может произойти, а может нет: *If I get home early, I'll call you.*

## Общие факты
Иногда if + Present simple, Present simple: правда всегда.
> **If** you heat ice, it **melts**. — Если нагреть лёд, он тает.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~If it will rain, we'll stay at home.~~ → **If it rains**, we'll stay at home.
- ~~If I'll see him, I'll tell him.~~ → **If I see** him, I'll tell him.
- ~~If you will come, I'll be happy.~~ → **If you come**, I'll be happy.
- ~~If you will hurry, you'll catch the bus.~~ → **If you hurry**, you'll catch the bus.
en:
## What if means
We use **if** to talk about something that can happen and what will happen then.
> **If** it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
> **If** you see Tom, tell him to call me.

## Rule: if + present simple, will + verb
After **if** we use **present simple** for the future, not **will**. The result uses **will**.
> **If** I **have** time, I'**ll help** you.
> **If** she **doesn't come**, we **won't start**.

## Word order
The **if**-part can come first (with a comma) or second (no comma).
> **If** you're late, I'll be angry. = I'll be angry **if** you're late.

## Instead of will
You can also use **can, may, must, should** or an imperative.
> If you're tired, **go** to bed. · If you want, you **can** stay.

## if and when
- **when**: it will certainly happen: *When I get home, I'll call you.*
- **if**: it may or may not happen: *If I get home early, I'll call you.*

## General facts
> **If** you heat ice, it **melts**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~If it will rain, we'll stay at home.~~ → **If it rains**, we'll stay at home.
- ~~If I'll see him, I'll tell him.~~ → **If I see** him, I'll tell him.
structure:
## Схема
| Часть с if | Главная часть | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| If + Present simple | will + глагол | If it rains, we'll stay in. |
| If + Present simple | won't + глагол | If you don't hurry, you won't catch the bus. |
| If + Present simple | команда | If you see Ann, say hello. |
| If + Present simple | Present simple | If you heat ice, it melts. |

## Формулы
> **If** + подлежащее + **Present simple**, подлежащее + **will** + глагол
> Подлежащее + **will** + глагол + **if** + подлежащее + **Present simple**

## Вопрос
> What **will** you do **if** you **miss** the bus? — I'll take a taxi.
> **Will** she be angry **if** I'm late? — Yes, she **will**. / No, she **won't**.

## Запомните
- Никакого **will** прямо после **if**.
- Запятая нужна, когда **if**-часть стоит первой.
- Отрицание: **if I don't ... / if she doesn't ...**; **won't** = will not.

exercises.title: Поставьте глагол в нужную форму
exercises.instruction: Present simple после **if**, **will / won't** в главной части.

items.text: If it {{rains}} tomorrow, we {{will stay|'ll stay}} at home. (rain / stay)
If you {{don't hurry|do not hurry}}, you {{will miss|'ll miss}} the bus. (not hurry / miss)
If I {{see}} Tom, I {{will tell|'ll tell}} him. (see / tell)
She {{will be|'ll be}} angry if you {{are|'re}} late. (be / be)
If we {{go}} by taxi, we {{will arrive|'ll arrive}} earlier. (go / arrive)
If he {{doesn't study|does not study}}, he {{won't pass|will not pass}} the exam. (not study / not pass)
I {{will help|'ll help}} you if you {{ask|want}} me to. (help / ask)
I'll buy that bag {{if}} it's not too expensive.
Call me {{when}} you arrive at the station. (ты точно приедешь)
{{If}} you see her, say hello. (может, увидишь)
{{When}} the lesson ends, we'll go for coffee.
We'll have a picnic {{if}} the weather is nice.
I'll give you the book {{when}} I finish it.

items.q: If you ___ hard, you'll pass the exam.
If it's cold, I ___ my coat.
If she ___ late, we'll start without her.
What will you do if you ___ your keys?
If you don't hurry, you ___ the train.
I'll be happy if you ___ to my party.
If you heat water to 100 degrees, it ___.
Как сказать «Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома»?
options: If it will rain, we stay at home.
If it rains, we'll stay at home.
If it rains, we stay at home tomorrow.

items.q: Как сказать «Если ты опоздаешь, я не буду ждать»?
options: If you are late, I won't wait.
If you will be late, I don't wait.
If you are late, I didn't wait.

items.q: Как сказать «Что ты будешь делать, если не получишь работу?»
options: What will you do if you will not get the job?
What do you do if you won't get the job?
What will you do if you don't get the job?

items.q: Как сказать «Я позвоню, если мне понадобится помощь»?
options: I'll call you if I need help.
I'll call you if I'll need help.
I call you if I will need help.

items.q: Как сказать «Если увидишь Тома, скажи ему привет»?
options: If you will see Tom, say hello.
If you see Tom, say hello.
If you saw Tom, say hello.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Закончите предложения о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: If the weather is nice this weekend, I ...
items.sample: If the weather is nice this weekend, I'll go for a walk in the park.

items.prompt: If I have free time tonight, I ...
items.sample: If I have free time tonight, I'll watch a film.

items.prompt: If I don't sleep well, I ...
